_comment: Scope for the POWH dermatology journal club. Each query is run against PubMed/NCBI by fetch_pubmed.py. Edit the volume/issue numbers (and section labels) for a new journal club, then run: python3 journal-club/fetch_pubmed.py && python3 journal-club/generate_report.py. Section labels must match JOURNAL_META in generate_report.py. Issue->month for these journals: JAAD vol92 iss4=Apr/iss5=May 2025; AJD vol66 iss3=May 2025; BJD vol192 iss2=Feb/iss3=Mar/iss4=Apr 2025.

queries.term: "J Am Acad Dermatol"[Journal] AND 92[Volume] AND (4[Issue] OR 5[Issue]) AND (Review[pt] OR "Systematic Review"[pt] OR "Meta-Analysis"[pt] OR "Practice Guideline"[pt] OR Guideline[pt])

"J Am Acad Dermatol"[Journal] AND 92[Volume] AND (4[Issue] OR 5[Issue]) NOT Review[pt] NOT "Systematic Review"[pt] NOT "Meta-Analysis"[pt] NOT "Practice Guideline"[pt] NOT Guideline[pt] NOT Letter[pt] NOT Editorial[pt] NOT Comment[pt] NOT "Published Erratum"[pt] NOT "Case Reports"[pt] NOT News[pt] NOT Biography[pt]
"Br J Dermatol"[Journal] AND 192[Volume] AND 3[Issue] AND (Review[pt] OR "Systematic Review"[pt])
"Br J Dermatol"[Journal] AND 192[Volume] AND 2[Issue] AND (Review[pt] OR "Systematic Review"[pt])
"Br J Dermatol"[Journal] AND 192[Volume] AND 4[Issue] AND (Review[pt] OR "Systematic Review"[pt])
queries.section: Reviews — April issue (192/4), online in Feb–Mar

queries._comment: BJD vol 192 Suppl 1 (HS themed, Feb 2025); supplements are hard to address by [Issue], so pinned by PMID.
